figures.caption: Table 5. Empirical size of nominal-5% t-tests under within-X̃ heteroskedasticity. Balanced TWFE, n = 2000, R = 5000 replications per cell. DGP: σ2 i = σ2 u(1 + X̃2 i /QK)/2 so that ω2 = 2σ2 u and a naive computation would predict µ ≈ σ2 u ̸= ω2. HC2 size remains within 1.6 percentage points of nominal across the grid, supporting Remark 3.2: balanced symmetric FE designs with i.i.d. sampling preserve µ ≈ ω2 even when σ2 i depends on X̃i. Monte Carlo SEs in parentheses.
